Name: Peachy Objects 1.6 items variation
Author: Lun1e
Description:
[color=#ea9999][b][u]UPDATE![/u][/b][/color]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4908]Peachy Objects[/url] has now been officially updated! I’m leaving this up for people who want slightly different colours than the official version, but please feel free to remove this mod from your mod list and just get the latest version of Peachy Objects from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42583370]Peachitto[/url]﻿! ♥️
I won't make any more changes to this mod as it's fulfilled its purpose and is no longer needed.[/size]

This is a very basic mod that applies colours changes to Peachy Objects icons for jelly, pickles, wine, and juice to make use of 1.6's new colours inclusion.
All credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42583370]Peachitto[/url]﻿'s original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4908]Peachy Objects[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/8170278]Cheerybelle[/url] for ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20755]SCAGI[/url]﻿ which is what I used as a base for this one.

Manifest.Name: Peachy Objects 1.6 fix
Manifest.Description: This fixes the icons for jelly, pickles, wine, juice, and honey to match Peachy Objects with 1.6's new colour mode.
